verdict.rationale: Munito AI is an open-model inference provider, and fine-tuning plus serving is a fair question for that kind of platform, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only inference APIs (chat, tools, speech to text, document extraction) and model selection, with no fine-tuning jobs, training-data upload or custom-model serving. The 'No training on your data' line is a data-privacy policy, not a fine-tuning capability.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune a supported base model on my own data and serve the result on the same platform
